newsitem.title: USA: Most preferred sought by CSW tendered.
newsitem.headline: Most preferred sought by CSW tendered.

text.p: Central and South West Corp said a preliminary count shows about 66 percent of the Central Power and Light Co preferred and 60 percent of the West Texas Utilities Co preferred sought in tender offers that expired Monday were tendered.

It also said West Texas shareholders, at a special meeting reconvened Tuesday, adopted an amendment to the company's restated articles of incorporation to eliminate a provision limiting the amount of unsecured debt that can be issued.
Central Power shareholders passed a similar amendment on April 7, Central and South West noted.
